items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Clifford Jordan and I were the front line.

ctx.x: Well, he had done a gig with Horace Silver who I saw in the club. I fell in love with him. He was commuting from… Then, when Art Farmer left Horace Silver’s, Horace used to me because I knew his music, me and Clifford Jordan. Clifford Jordan and I were the front line.
So, that's how you met him. How did you meet Lenny White?
